title: Very good
body:
Alright, wasn’t expecting much but this habit tracker is actually brilliant 😄 Super simple, no nonsense, just open it and get on with your day. I’ve tried a few before and they’re all like “premium this, subscription that”… here it’s just free, like properly FREE, which is rare these days lol. I love how clean everything is, no clutter, no confusing menus, you just tick your habits and that’s it. Feels a bit like having a quiet mate keeping you in check 😂 Been using it for a couple weeks now and I actually stick to my routines more, which is a miracle tbh.
Not perfect maybe, but honestly for something this simple and free, it does the job better than most paid apps. Proper gem this one

title: Great at first

title: One additional feature would make this perfect
body: I’ve just installed this app in order to gamify my habit building as I both need routine and struggle with it. (Hooray neurodivergence!) As someone who takes medication twice a day it would be incredibly helpful to have the ability to mark the same habit done twice a day, not just have two reminders for it. I imagine it would also be helpful for others in terms of tracking tooth brushing etc as well. If we could have repetitive habits with completely open repeats (3 times per week on x days or 2 times per day at y times) this app would be even more powerful
